title: Slipway front matter: post layout
description: A dated post. The date and slug come from the file name (YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md); `date` in the front matter overrides the date.

series.description: The name of the series the post belongs to. Posts with the same name and language form the series, oldest first; each shows a series box with its part, the other parts, and the previous and next part.

author.description: Who wrote the post: one key of `_data/authors.yml`, or a list of keys for several authors. The post shows a byline and an author box for each.
